composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Show Doraemon with his familiar blue round body, white face, red nose, whiskers, and small neck bell. One round hand lightly touches the bell while he smiles. Keep the new iris details small within his usual large white eye shapes, avoiding oversized colored eyeballs. Frame the upper body on pale blue paper, with no gadgets, writing, or extra decorative objects. Use crisp cel animation, economical shadow planes, and a clean pastel background. Give both irises gentle crimson color with three small black tomoe around visible pupils. Keep the pattern inside the irises, with clear highlights and a friendly gaze. Create an original, nonviolent fan-art avatar, square 1024x1024. Center the character's head and shoulders within 70-75% of the frame, safe for a circular crop. Show both eyes clearly. No text, watermark, weapons, or copied anime composition.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for recognizable character, readable requested eye motif, appealing expression, original nonviolent composition, coherent anatomy, no text or watermark
